p: judgment: That thing which is just and lawful, both to govern my people properly, and also to clear your own conscience.
who pluck off their skin from: The Prophet condemns the wicked governors not only of covetousness, theft, and murder, but compares them to wolves, lions, and most cruel beasts.

shall they cry unto the LORD: That is, when I will punish their wickedness: for though I hear the godly before they cry Isa 65:24, yet I will not hear these even though they cry; Isa 1:15 Eze 8:18; Jas 2:13; 1Pe 3:11-12.
bite with their teeth: They devour all their substance, and then flatter them, promising that all will go well. But if someone does not feed them, then they invent all ways to do evil.

night shall be unto you: As you have loved to walk in darkness, and to prophesy lies, so God will reward you with gross blindness and ignorance, so that when all others will see the bright beams of God's grace, you will as blind men grope as in the night.
their lips: When God will reveal them to the world, they will be afraid to speak: for all will know that they were but false prophets, and did give a false notion of the word of God.

of power by the spirit of: The Prophet being assured of his vocation by the Spirit of God, sets himself alone against all the wicked, showing how God gave him gifts, ability and knowledge, to discern between good and evil, and also steadfastness and endurance to reprove the sins of the people, and not to flatter them.
blood: They will say that they are the people of God, and abuse his name, as a pretence to disguise their hypocrisy.
plowed as a field: Read Jer 26:18.
